title: Signal: OS command execution via os.execute (lua) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on the os.execute call in lua code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: any os.execute call matches, including fully trusted invocations. Dataflow from untrusted input is not proven — treat every hit as review-required.
fpNotes: Trusted, hardcoded commands (no variables) are the common false positive; confirm no interpolated input before dismissing.
